source.text: ἔκρινα γὰρ ἐμαυτῷ τοῦτο, τὸ μὴ πάλιν ἐν λύπῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐλθεῖν·

records.literal_gloss: I decided for indeed for myself this, the not again in grief to you to come;

en.L: For I decided this for myself, not to come to you again in grief.
en.B: For I settled this in my own mind: I would not come to you again bringing grief.
en.R: So I decided that I would not visit you again if it would be another sad visit like the last one.

fr.L: Car j’ai décidé ceci pour moi-même : ne pas revenir chez vous dans la tristesse.
fr.B: J’avais en effet pris pour moi cette décision : je ne reviendrais pas chez vous pour vous apporter de nouveau la tristesse.
fr.R: J’ai donc décidé de ne pas revenir vous voir, si c’était pour une autre visite triste comme la dernière.

es.L: Porque decidí esto para mí mismo: no ir otra vez a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con tristeza.
es.B: Así que tomé esta decisión en mi interior: no volvería a {{plural_you:visitarlos|visitaros}} para causar tristeza.
es.R: Por eso decidí no {{plural_you:visitarlos|visitaros}} otra vez si iba a ser otra visita triste como la anterior.

sw.L: Kwa maana niliamua hili kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, kutokuja kwenu tena katika huzuni.
sw.B: Kwa maana nilikwisha kuamua moyoni mwangu jambo hili: kwamba sitakuja kwenu tena nikiwaletea huzuni.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo niliamua kwamba sitawatembelea tena ikiwa ziara hiyo itakuwa ya huzuni kama ile ya mwisho.

vi.L: Vì tôi đã tự quyết định điều này: không đến với anh chị em một lần nữa trong sự buồn rầu.
vi.B: Vì tôi đã quyết định trong lòng điều này: tôi sẽ không đến với anh chị em một lần nữa để đem lại sự buồn rầu.
vi.R: Vì vậy, tôi đã quyết định không đến thăm anh chị em nữa, nếu đó lại là một chuyến thăm buồn bã như lần trước.

ko.L: 나는 다시 슬픔 가운데 여러분에게 가지 않기로 스스로 결심했습니다.
ko.B: 나는 다시는 슬픔을 안고 여러분에게 가지 않기로 마음속으로 정했습니다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 지난번처럼 또 슬픈 방문이 될 것 같으면 여러분을 다시 찾아가지 않기로 했습니다.

pt.L: Pois decidi isto comigo mesmo: não ir outra vez até vocês em tristeza.
pt.B: Pois tomei esta decisão comigo mesmo: eu não iria outra vez até vocês trazendo tristeza.
pt.R: Por isso decidi que não ia visitar vocês de novo se fosse para ser outra visita triste como a última.

am.L: እንደ ገና በሐዘን ወደ እናንተ እንዳልመጣ ይህን ለራሴ ወስኛለሁና።
am.B: እንደ ገና ሐዘን ይዤ ወደ እናንተ እንዳልመጣ በልቤ ቁርጥ አድርጌ ወስኛለሁና።
am.R: ስለዚህ እንደ ባለፈው ጊዜ የሚያሳዝን ጉብኝት የሚሆን ከሆነ እንደ ገና ልጎበኛችሁ እንደማልመጣ ወሰንኩ።

decisions.choice: "for" explains 1:23: Paul stayed away from Corinth to spare them
alternatives: a new step in the argument
decisions.reason: γὰρ ("for") ties this sentence to 1:23, where Paul calls God as witness that he did not come to Corinth in order to spare them. Here he says what he decided and why.

decisions.choice: "again" goes with "in grief": an earlier visit had already been a painful one
alternatives: "again" goes only with "come": not to come again, this time in grief
decisions.reason: πάλιν ("again") stands next to "in grief", so the most natural sense is that one visit had already been full of grief. Acts does not tell of it, but 12:14 and 13:1-2 speak of a coming third visit, so Paul had been to Corinth a second time, and this chapter suggests that visit went badly (verse 5).

decisions.choice: grief: sorrow and pain of heart, both felt and caused
decisions.reason: λύπῃ is grief or distress of mind. The word and its verb run through verses 1-7 (and again in 7:8-11): Paul does not want to cause grief or to suffer it. A visit "in grief" would bring sorrow to them and to him alike.

decisions.choice: for my own part: a settled decision of Paul's own
decisions.reason: ἐμαυτῷ ("for myself") marks the decision as Paul's own, made in his own mind. It could also mean that he decided this for his own good, but verses 2-3 show that his concern is for them and for their shared joy.

decisions.choice: grief (L, B); sad (R)
decisions.reason: The same word family runs through verses 1-7, so each level keeps one English family for it: grief and grieve at Literal and Balanced, sad and sadness at Readable.

decisions.choice: another sad visit like the last one
decisions.reason: Readable says what "again" implies: the previous visit had been a sad one (m2).

decisions.choice: la tristesse, attrister (L, B); triste, rendre triste (R) (for the whole book)
alternatives: la peine, faire de la peine
decisions.reason: The same word family runs through verses 1-7 and returns in chapter 7, so each level keeps one French family for it, as the English does with "grief" and "sad". "Tristesse" and "attrister" share a root, as the Greek noun and verb do, and cover sorrow both felt and caused (m3).

decisions.choice: tristeza, entristecer (L, B); triste (R)
decisions.reason: The grief word comes back again and again in chapters 2 and 7, so Literal and Balanced keep one word family, "tristeza / entristecer", which covers sorrow both felt and caused (meaning decision); Readable uses the everyday "triste" and "poner triste".

decisions.choice: huzuni, kuhuzunisha (every level)
decisions.reason: Grief runs through 2:1-7 and 7:8-11. "Huzuni" and its verb "kuhuzunisha" are everyday Swahili, so all three levels keep the one family, where the English Readable changes to "sad". "Masikitiko" is closer to regret.

decisions.choice: "sự buồn rầu", "làm cho buồn rầu" (L, B); "buồn", "làm cho buồn" (R) for lype and lypeo (2:1-7; chapter 7)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: "grief, grieve" (L, B), "sad, sadness" (R); one Vietnamese word is kept at each level so the reader hears the word return as often as the Greek repeats it.

decisions.choice: "như lần trước" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable does, Readable says that an earlier visit had already been painful (m2).

decisions.choice: "슬픔", "슬프게 하다" for grief and grieving at every level, through verses 1-7 and 7:8-11
decisions.reason: The project keeps one word for this family through both passages; "슬픔" is the plain current word, where "근심" now suggests worry.

decisions.choice: tristeza, entristecer (L, B); triste, deixar triste (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (chapters 2 and 7). "Tristeza" and "entristecer" are one family, as the Greek noun and verb are, and cover both sorrow felt and sorrow caused (m3); "mágoa" would suggest resentment, and "dor" pain of any kind. Readable uses the everyday "triste" and "deixar triste", as the English Readable says "sad".

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God and Christ has nothing to change in Amharic; the pronouns (እርሱ, the verb endings) are written once, with no span.

decisions.choice: ሐዘን, ማዘን, ማሳዘን at every level
decisions.reason: One word family for grief runs through 2:1-7 and chapter 7, so every level keeps it: ሐዘን, 'grief', with ማዘን 'to be grieved' and ማሳዘን 'to grieve someone'. Readable uses the same words, which are already plain Amharic for 'sad'.

source.text: εἰ γὰρ ἐγὼ λυπῶ ὑμᾶς, καὶ τίς ὁ εὐφραίνων με εἰ μὴ ὁ λυπούμενος ἐξ ἐμοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: If for I grieve you, and who [is] the [one] gladdening me except the [one] being grieved by me?

en.L: For if I grieve you, then who is [there] to make me glad except the one who is grieved by me?
en.B: For if I grieve you, who is left to make me glad, except the very ones I have grieved?
en.R: If I make you sad, who will be left to make me happy? Only you, the people I made sad!

fr.L: Car si moi je vous attriste, qui donc [est là pour] me réjouir, sinon celui qui est attristé par moi ?
fr.B: Car si je vous attriste, qui reste-t-il pour me rendre la joie, sinon ceux-là mêmes que j’ai attristés ?
fr.R: Si je vous rends tristes, qui va me rendre heureux ? Personne d’autre que vous, les gens que j’ai rendus tristes !

es.L: Porque si yo {{plural_you:los|os}} entristezco, ¿quién [hay] entonces que me alegre, sino el que es entristecido por mí?
es.B: Porque si yo {{plural_you:los|os}} entristezco, ¿quién queda para alegrarme, sino precisamente aquellos a quienes he entristecido?
es.R: Si yo {{plural_you:los|os}} pongo tristes, ¿quién va a quedar para alegrarme? ¡Solo {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, las personas a quienes puse tristes!

sw.L: Kwa maana ikiwa mimi nawahuzunisha ninyi, basi ni nani [aliyepo] wa kunifurahisha isipokuwa yule anayehuzunishwa nami?
sw.B: Kwa maana ikiwa mimi nawahuzunisha ninyi, ni nani atakayebaki kunifurahisha, isipokuwa ninyi wenyewe niliowahuzunisha?
sw.R: Nikiwahuzunisha ninyi, ni nani atakayebaki kunifurahisha? Ni ninyi tu, watu niliowahuzunisha!

vi.L: Vì nếu tôi làm cho anh chị em buồn rầu, thì ai là người làm cho tôi vui, ngoại trừ người bị tôi làm cho buồn rầu?
vi.B: Vì nếu tôi làm cho anh chị em buồn rầu, thì còn ai làm cho tôi vui, ngoài chính những người tôi đã làm cho buồn rầu?
vi.R: Nếu tôi làm cho anh chị em buồn, thì ai sẽ còn lại để làm cho tôi vui? Chỉ có anh chị em, là những người tôi đã làm cho buồn!

ko.L: 내가 여러분을 슬프게 한다면, 나에게 슬픔을 받은 사람 말고 누가 나를 기쁘게 하겠습니까?
ko.B: 내가 여러분을 슬프게 한다면, 내가 슬프게 한 바로 그 사람들 말고 누가 나를 기쁘게 해 주겠습니까?
ko.R: 내가 여러분을 슬프게 하면, 누가 나를 기쁘게 해 주겠습니까? 내가 슬프게 한 여러분밖에 없습니다!

pt.L: Pois, se eu entristeço vocês, quem [há] para me alegrar, senão aquele que é entristecido por mim?
pt.B: Pois, se eu entristeço vocês, quem sobra para me alegrar, a não ser justamente aqueles que entristeci?
pt.R: Se eu deixar vocês tristes, quem vai sobrar para me deixar feliz? Só vocês, as pessoas que eu deixei tristes!

am.L: እኔ ባሳዝናችሁ፣ በእኔ ከሚያዝነው በቀር ደስ የሚያሰኘኝ ማን [አለ]?
am.B: እኔ ባሳዝናችሁ፣ ካሳዘንኳችሁ ከእናንተ በቀር ደስ የሚያሰኘኝ ማን ይቀራል?
am.R: እኔ ባሳዝናችሁ፣ ደስ የሚያሰኘኝ ማን ይቀራል? ያሳዘንኳችሁ እናንተ ብቻ ናችሁ!

decisions.choice: "the one grieved by me" is the church as a whole, spoken of as one person
alternatives: the man who caused the trouble (verses 5-7)
decisions.reason: The singular picks up ὑμᾶς ("you", plural) in the first half of the verse: if Paul grieves the church, the only people who could cheer him are the very people he has grieved. The offender of verses 5-7 is not yet in view.

decisions.choice: a question expecting the answer: no one but you
decisions.reason: καὶ at the head of the question gives it force ("then who...?"). Paul's joy depends on theirs, as verse 3 says, so to grieve them would leave him with no one to make him glad.

decisions.choice: the very ones (B); the people (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek singular speaks of the whole church as one (m1); Balanced and Readable say "ones" and "people" so that the reader does not think of one individual.

decisions.choice: yule anayehuzunishwa nami (singular)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the singular, the church spoken of as one person (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say "ninyi", as the English says "the very ones".

source.text: καὶ ἔγραψα τοῦτο αὐτὸ ἵνα μὴ ἐλθὼν λύπην σχῶ ἀφ’ ὧν ἔδει με χαίρειν, πεποιθὼς ἐπὶ πάντας ὑμᾶς ὅτι ἡ ἐμὴ χαρὰ πάντων ὑμῶν ἐστιν.

records.literal_gloss: And I wrote this very thing so that not having come grief I might have from [those] whom it was necessary me to rejoice, having been persuaded about all you that the my joy of all of you is.

en.L: And I wrote this very thing so that, when I came, I would not have grief from those from whom I ought to rejoice, being confident about all of you that my joy is [the joy] of all of you.
en.B: That is the very reason I wrote to you before: so that when I came I would not be grieved by the very people who ought to give me joy. For I was sure of every one of you, sure that what gives me joy gives joy to all of you.
en.R: That is why I wrote that letter to you. I did not want to come and be made sad by the very people who should make me glad. I was sure that when I have joy, all of you have joy too.

fr.L: Et j’ai écrit cela même, afin qu’en venant je n’aie pas de tristesse de la part de ceux dont je devrais me réjouir, ayant confiance en vous tous que ma joie est [celle] de vous tous.
fr.B: C’est justement pour cela que je vous ai écrit auparavant : pour qu’à mon arrivée je ne sois pas attristé par ceux-là mêmes qui devraient me donner de la joie. Car j’avais confiance en chacun de vous, sûr que ce qui fait ma joie fait aussi la joie de vous tous.
fr.R: C’est pour cela que je vous ai écrit cette lettre. Je ne voulais pas venir et être rendu triste par les gens mêmes qui devraient me rendre heureux. J’étais sûr que, quand j’ai de la joie, vous avez tous de la joie, vous aussi.

es.L: Y escribí esto mismo para que, al llegar, no tuviera tristeza de parte de aquellos por quienes debía alegrarme, confiando en todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en que mi gozo es [el gozo] de todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Esa fue precisamente la razón por la que {{plural_you:les|os}} escribí antes: para que, cuando llegara, no me entristecieran las mismas personas que debían darme alegría. Porque estaba seguro de cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, seguro de que lo que me da alegría a mí {{plural_you:les|os}} da alegría a todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} escribí aquella carta. No quería llegar y que me pusieran triste las mismas personas que debían alegrarme. Estaba seguro de que, cuando yo tengo alegría, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} también la {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}}.

sw.L: Na niliandika jambo hili hili ili nikija nisipate huzuni kutoka kwa wale ambao ilinipasa kufurahi kwa ajili yao, nikiwa na uhakika juu yenu nyote kwamba furaha yangu ni [furaha] yenu nyote.
sw.B: Hiyo ndiyo sababu hasa niliwaandikia hapo awali: ili nikija nisihuzunishwe na watu wale wale ambao wangepaswa kunipa furaha. Kwa maana nilikuwa na uhakika juu ya kila mmoja wenu, kwamba kinachonipa furaha kinawapa furaha ninyi nyote.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu niliwaandikia ile barua. Sikutaka kuja na kuhuzunishwa na watu wale wale ambao wangenifurahisha. Nilikuwa na uhakika kwamba ninapokuwa na furaha, ninyi nyote mnakuwa na furaha pia.

vi.L: Và tôi đã viết chính điều này, để khi đến, tôi không bị buồn rầu bởi những người đáng lẽ phải làm cho tôi vui mừng, vì tôi tin chắc về tất cả anh chị em rằng niềm vui của tôi cũng là [niềm vui] của tất cả anh chị em.
vi.B: Đó chính là lý do trước đây tôi đã viết thư cho anh chị em: để khi tôi đến, tôi không bị buồn rầu bởi chính những người đáng lẽ phải đem lại niềm vui cho tôi. Vì tôi tin chắc về từng người trong anh chị em, tin chắc rằng điều gì làm tôi vui cũng làm cho tất cả anh chị em vui.
vi.R: Vì vậy tôi đã viết lá thư ấy cho anh chị em. Tôi không muốn đến rồi lại bị buồn vì chính những người lẽ ra phải làm cho tôi vui. Tôi tin chắc rằng khi tôi vui, thì tất cả anh chị em cũng vui.

ko.L: 내가 바로 이것을 쓴 것은, 내가 갔을 때 나를 기쁘게 해야 할 사람들에게서 슬픔을 얻지 않으려는 것이었습니다. 나의 기쁨이 여러분 모두의 기쁨이라는 것을 여러분 모두에 대해 확신하기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 바로 그래서 내가 전에 여러분에게 편지를 쓴 것입니다. 내가 갔을 때 나에게 기쁨을 주어야 할 사람들 때문에 슬퍼하지 않으려는 것이었습니다. 나는 여러분 모두에 대해 확신했습니다. 나를 기쁘게 하는 것이 여러분 모두를 기쁘게 한다는 것을 말입니다.
ko.R: 그래서 내가 그 편지를 여러분에게 썼습니다. 나는 여러분을 찾아가서, 나를 기쁘게 해 주어야 할 바로 그 사람들 때문에 슬퍼하고 싶지 않았습니다. 나는 내가 기쁘면 여러분 모두도 기쁘다는 것을 확신했습니다.

pt.L: E escrevi isto mesmo para que, quando eu fosse, não tivesse tristeza da parte daqueles de quem eu devia me alegrar, confiando em todos vocês de que a minha alegria é [a alegria] de todos vocês.
pt.B: Foi exatamente por isso que lhes escrevi antes: para que, quando eu chegasse, não ficasse triste por causa justamente das pessoas que deviam me dar alegria. Pois eu tinha certeza a respeito de cada um de vocês, certeza de que aquilo que me dá alegria dá alegria a todos vocês.
pt.R: Foi por isso que escrevi aquela carta a vocês. Eu não queria chegar e ficar triste por causa justamente das pessoas que deviam me deixar alegre. Eu tinha certeza de que, quando eu tenho alegria, todos vocês também têm alegria.

am.L: ይህንኑም የጻፍኩት በመጣኩ ጊዜ ደስ ሊያሰኙኝ ከሚገባቸው ሐዘን እንዳይደርስብኝ ነው፤ የእኔ ደስታ የሁላችሁ [ደስታ] እንደ ሆነ በሁላችሁ ላይ ተማምኜ ነው።
am.B: ቀደም ብዬ የጻፍኩላችሁም ለዚሁ ነው፤ በመጣኩ ጊዜ ደስታ ሊሰጡኝ በሚገባቸው ሰዎች እንዳላዝን ነው። በሁላችሁ ላይ እተማመን ነበርና፤ እኔን ደስ የሚያሰኘኝ ሁላችሁንም ደስ እንደሚያሰኛችሁ እርግጠኛ ነበርኩ።
am.R: ያንን ደብዳቤ የጻፍኩላችሁ ለዚህ ነው። ደስ ሊያሰኙኝ በሚገባቸው ሰዎች ለማዘን መምጣት አልፈለግኩም። እኔ ደስ ሲለኝ ሁላችሁም ደስ እንደሚላችሁ እርግጠኛ ነበርኩ።

decisions.choice: "I wrote" refers to an earlier letter, sent in place of a visit
alternatives: this present letter (a letter writer's "I wrote" meaning "I am writing")
decisions.reason: In verse 4 Paul describes this letter as written with many tears, and in 7:8 he says a letter of his grieved them; neither fits the present letter. Whether the earlier letter is 1 Corinthians or a letter that has not survived cannot be settled from the text; 1 Corinthians does not read like a letter written in tears, so many readers think of a lost letter.

decisions.choice: for this very reason: the purpose stated in the next clause
alternatives: "this very thing" as the content of the letter
decisions.reason: τοῦτο αὐτὸ can be the object ("I wrote this very thing") or can mean "for this very reason". The clause that follows gives the purpose of the letter, and nothing in verses 1-2 is the sort of thing the letter could have said, so it most likely points forward.

decisions.choice: Paul trusted that his joy and theirs are bound together
alternatives: Paul trusted that they would make him glad
decisions.reason: πεποιθὼς ("having been persuaded") gives the ground of his writing. "My joy is of all of you" means that what makes Paul glad makes them glad too; so they would want to set things right before he came.

decisions.choice: before (B); that letter (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that Paul is speaking of a letter he had already sent (m1).

decisions.choice: what gives me joy gives joy to all of you
alternatives: my joy is the joy of all of you
decisions.reason: Balanced turns the Greek possessive into a clause so that the shared joy is plain.

decisions.choice: lo que me da alegría a mí les da alegría a todos ustedes
alternatives: mi alegría es la de todos ustedes
decisions.reason: "Mi alegría es la de todos ustedes" could be read as Paul taking their joy for himself; turning it round says that his joy and theirs are bound together (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "trước đây tôi đã viết thư" (B); "lá thư ấy" (R)
decisions.reason: As the book-wide choice reads it, "I wrote" refers to an earlier, tearful letter sent in place of a visit, not 1 Corinthians (m1); the words supplied do not name which letter.

decisions.choice: "전에" (B), "그 편지" (R) for the letter Paul wrote
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "I wrote" as an earlier, tearful letter sent in place of a visit, not 1 Corinthians, uncertain and footnoted; Korean does not say "this letter".

source.text: ἐκ γὰρ πολλῆς θλίψεως καὶ συνοχῆς καρδίας ἔγραψα ὑμῖν διὰ πολλῶν δακρύων, οὐχ ἵνα λυπηθῆτε, ἀλλὰ τὴν ἀγάπην ἵνα γνῶτε ἣν ἔχω περισσοτέρως εἰς ὑμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: Out of for much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you through many tears, not so that you might be grieved, but the love so that you might know which I have more abundantly toward you.

en.L: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you through many tears, not so that you would be grieved, but so that you would know the love that I have so abundantly for you.
en.B: I wrote to you out of great affliction and anguish of heart, and with many tears. I did not write to make you grieve. I wrote so that you would come to know my love, which overflows toward you above all.
en.R: When I wrote to you, I was in great trouble and my heart was hurting, and I cried many tears. I did not write to make you sad. I wrote so that you would know how very much I love you.

fr.L: Car c’est dans une grande détresse et l’angoisse du cœur que je vous ai écrit, avec beaucoup de larmes, non pour que vous soyez attristés, mais pour que vous connaissiez l’amour que j’ai si abondamment pour vous.
fr.B: Je vous ai écrit dans une grande détresse, le cœur serré par l’angoisse, et avec beaucoup de larmes. Je ne vous ai pas écrit pour vous attrister. Je vous ai écrit pour que vous connaissiez l’amour que j’ai pour vous, un amour qui déborde vers vous plus que vers tout autre.
fr.R: Quand je vous ai écrit, j’avais de grandes difficultés et mon cœur souffrait. J’ai versé beaucoup de larmes. Je ne vous ai pas écrit pour vous rendre tristes. Je vous ai écrit pour que vous sachiez combien je vous aime.

es.L: Porque en medio de mucha aflicción y angustia de corazón {{plural_you:les|os}} escribí con muchas lágrimas, no para que {{plural_you:fueran|fuerais}} entristecidos, sino para que {{plural_you:conocieran|conocierais}} el amor que tengo tan abundantemente por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} escribí en medio de una gran aflicción y angustia de corazón, y con muchas lágrimas. No escribí para {{plural_you:entristecerlos|entristeceros}}, sino para que {{plural_you:conocieran|conocierais}} mi amor, que se desborda hacia {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} más que hacia nadie.
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:les|os}} escribí, estaba pasando por grandes problemas, me dolía el corazón y lloré mucho. No escribí para {{plural_you:ponerlos|poneros}} tristes. Escribí para que {{plural_you:supieran|supierais}} cuánto {{plural_you:los|os}} amo.

sw.L: Kwa maana kutoka katika dhiki nyingi na uchungu wa moyo niliwaandikia kwa machozi mengi, si ili mhuzunishwe, bali ili mjue upendo nilio nao kwenu kwa wingi zaidi.
sw.B: Niliwaandikia kutoka katika dhiki kubwa na uchungu wa moyo, nikitoa machozi mengi. Sikuandika ili kuwahuzunisha. Niliandika ili mpate kuujua upendo wangu, unaofurika kwenu kuliko kwa wengine wote.
sw.R: Nilipowaandikia, nilikuwa katika taabu kubwa, moyo wangu ulikuwa ukiumia, na nililia machozi mengi. Sikuandika ili kuwahuzunisha. Niliandika ili mjue jinsi ninavyowapenda sana.

vi.L: Vì từ nhiều hoạn nạn và nỗi đau khổ trong lòng, tôi đã viết cho anh chị em với nhiều nước mắt, không phải để anh chị em buồn rầu, nhưng để anh chị em biết tình yêu thương dồi dào mà tôi có đối với anh chị em.
vi.B: Tôi đã viết cho anh chị em trong nhiều hoạn nạn và đau đớn trong lòng, với nhiều nước mắt. Tôi không viết để làm cho anh chị em buồn rầu. Tôi viết để anh chị em biết tình yêu thương của tôi, là tình yêu thương tràn đầy hơn hết đối với anh chị em.
vi.R: Khi viết cho anh chị em, tôi đang gặp nhiều khó khăn, lòng tôi đau đớn, và tôi đã khóc rất nhiều. Tôi không viết để làm cho anh chị em buồn. Tôi viết để anh chị em biết tôi yêu thương anh chị em biết bao.

ko.L: 나는 많은 환난과 마음의 괴로움 가운데 많은 눈물을 흘리며 여러분에게 썼습니다. 여러분을 슬프게 하려는 것이 아니라, 내가 여러분에게 넘치도록 품고 있는 사랑을 여러분이 알게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.B: 나는 큰 환난과 마음의 고통 속에서 많은 눈물을 흘리며 여러분에게 편지를 썼습니다. 여러분을 슬프게 하려고 쓴 것이 아닙니다. 내가 여러분을 특별히 넘치도록 사랑한다는 것을 여러분이 알게 하려고 쓴 것입니다.
ko.R: 내가 여러분에게 편지를 쓸 때, 나는 큰 어려움을 겪고 있었고 마음이 몹시 아팠습니다. 그래서 눈물을 많이 흘렸습니다. 나는 여러분을 슬프게 하려고 쓰지 않았습니다. 내가 여러분을 얼마나 사랑하는지 알게 하려고 썼습니다.

pt.L: Pois de muita aflição e angústia de coração eu lhes escrevi com muitas lágrimas, não para que vocês fossem entristecidos, mas para que conhecessem o amor que tenho tão abundantemente por vocês.
pt.B: Escrevi a vocês em meio a grande tribulação e angústia de coração, e com muitas lágrimas. Não escrevi para entristecê-los. Escrevi para que vocês viessem a conhecer o meu amor, que transborda para com vocês mais do que para com qualquer outro.
pt.R: Quando escrevi a vocês, eu estava passando por grandes dificuldades, o meu coração doía, e chorei muito. Não escrevi para deixar vocês tristes. Escrevi para que vocês soubessem o quanto eu amo vocês.

am.L: በብዙ ጭንቅና በልብ ጭንቀት በብዙ እንባ ጻፍኩላችሁና፤ ይህም እንድታዝኑ ሳይሆን ለእናንተ አብልጬ ያለኝን ፍቅር እንድታውቁ ነው።
am.B: በታላቅ መከራና በልብ ጭንቀት፣ በብዙ እንባም ጻፍኩላችሁ። የጻፍኩት እንድታዝኑ አልነበረም፤ የጻፍኩት ይልቁንም ከሁሉ በላይ ወደ እናንተ የሚትረፈረፈውን ፍቅሬን እንድታውቁ ነው።
am.R: በጻፍኩላችሁ ጊዜ በታላቅ ችግር ውስጥ ነበርኩ፤ ልቤም ይቆስል ነበር፤ ብዙ እንባም አለቀስኩ። የጻፍኩት እንድታዝኑ አልነበረም። የጻፍኩት ምን ያህል እንደምወዳችሁ እንድታውቁ ነው።

decisions.choice: heavy distress and anguish of heart over the church
decisions.reason: θλίψεως is pressure or affliction, and συνοχῆς a squeezing, a heart in anguish. Here the trouble is inward: Paul's distress over the church at Corinth, which he describes again in 7:5 ("fears within").

decisions.choice: with many tears: the tears that went with the writing
decisions.reason: διὰ with a genitive can mean the circumstances in which something is done. Paul wept as he wrote.

decisions.choice: the love is stressed
decisions.reason: Paul puts "the love" ahead of "so that you might know", where it would usually come after. The order sets his love against the grief they might think he intended.

decisions.choice: abundantly, especially: a love that overflows toward them
alternatives: strictly comparative: more than toward any other church
decisions.reason: περισσοτέρως is a comparative form, but Paul often uses such forms simply to mean "very much, especially". He may be hinting that he loves Corinth more than others (compare 12:15), but the main point is the greatness of his love.

decisions.choice: how very much I love you
alternatives: the love which I have especially for you
decisions.reason: Readable turns the noun "love" into a verb and keeps the stress on how great it is (m4).

decisions.choice: une grande détresse (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced usually says "épreuve" for this word, but here it is paired with anguish of heart and means distress felt inside (m1), as the English Balanced keeps "affliction" here; "détresse" says that.

decisions.choice: aflicción
decisions.reason: Elsewhere Balanced says "dificultad" for this word, but here it is set beside anguish of heart and names Paul's inner distress over the church (meaning decision), which "dificultad" does not say.

decisions.choice: uchungu wa moyo
decisions.reason: "Uchungu wa moyo" (bitterness of heart) is the Swahili idiom for deep anguish, without the sense of resentment that "uchungu" alone can have.

source.text: Εἰ δέ τις λελύπηκεν, οὐκ ἐμὲ λελύπηκεν, ἀλλὰ ἀπὸ μέρους ἵνα μὴ ἐπιβαρῶ πάντας ὑμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: If but anyone has grieved, not me he has grieved, but in part, so that not I may burden, all you.

en.L: But if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me, but in part, so that I may not be too severe, all of you.
en.B: Now if someone has caused grief, he has caused it not to me but to all of you, at least in part (I do not want to press the point too hard).
en.R: Now someone has caused sadness. But it is not my sadness that matters here. In some ways he has made all of you sad, though I do not want to say it too harshly.

fr.L: Or si quelqu’un a causé de la tristesse, ce n’est pas moi qu’il a attristé, mais en partie, pour ne pas exagérer, vous tous.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un a causé de la tristesse, ce n’est pas à moi qu’il l’a causée, mais à vous tous, du moins en partie (je ne veux pas trop appuyer).
fr.R: Quelqu’un a causé de la tristesse. Mais ce n’est pas ma tristesse qui compte ici. D’une certaine façon, il vous a rendus tristes, vous tous, même si je ne veux pas le dire trop durement.

es.L: Pero si alguien ha causado tristeza, no me ha entristecido a mí, sino en parte, para no exagerar, a todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Ahora bien, si alguien ha causado tristeza, no me la ha causado a mí, sino, al menos en parte, a todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} (no quiero cargar demasiado las tintas).
es.R: Alguien ha causado tristeza. Pero aquí no importa mi tristeza. De alguna manera, ese hombre {{plural_you:los|os}} ha puesto tristes a todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, aunque no quiero decirlo con demasiada dureza.

sw.L: Lakini ikiwa mtu amesababisha huzuni, hakunihuzunisha mimi, bali kwa sehemu, nisije nikazidisha, amewahuzunisha ninyi nyote.
sw.B: Basi ikiwa mtu fulani amesababisha huzuni, hakunisababishia mimi, bali amewasababishia ninyi nyote, angalau kwa sehemu (sitaki kulitilia jambo hili uzito kupita kiasi).
sw.R: Sasa kuna mtu aliyeleta huzuni. Lakini si huzuni yangu inayohusika hapa. Kwa namna fulani amewahuzunisha ninyi nyote, ingawa sitaki kulisema hili kwa ukali.

vi.L: Nhưng nếu có ai đã gây buồn rầu, thì người ấy không gây buồn rầu cho tôi, nhưng phần nào, để tôi không nói quá nặng, cho tất cả anh chị em.
vi.B: Nếu có người nào đã gây buồn rầu, thì người ấy không gây buồn rầu cho tôi, nhưng cho tất cả anh chị em, ít ra là phần nào (tôi không muốn nói quá nặng).
vi.R: Có một người đã gây ra nỗi buồn. Nhưng nỗi buồn của tôi không phải là điều quan trọng ở đây. Theo một cách nào đó, người ấy đã làm cho tất cả anh chị em buồn, dù tôi không muốn nói điều đó quá nặng lời.

ko.L: 누가 슬픔을 주었다면, 그는 나를 슬프게 한 것이 아니라, 어느 정도는 — 너무 지나치게 말하지 않으려는 것입니다 — 여러분 모두를 [슬프게 한 것입니다].
ko.B: 누가 슬픔을 주었다면, 그 사람은 나를 슬프게 한 것이 아니라 어느 정도는 여러분 모두를 슬프게 한 것입니다. (너무 심하게 말하고 싶지는 않습니다.)
ko.R: 어떤 사람이 슬픔을 주었습니다. 그러나 여기서 중요한 것은 내 슬픔이 아닙니다. 그 사람은 어떤 면에서 여러분 모두를 슬프게 했습니다. 하지만 나는 이 말을 너무 심하게 하고 싶지는 않습니다.

pt.L: Mas, se alguém causou tristeza, não entristeceu a mim, mas em parte, para que eu não exagere, a todos vocês.
pt.B: Ora, se alguém causou tristeza, não a causou a mim, mas a todos vocês, pelo menos em parte (não quero exagerar).
pt.R: Alguém causou tristeza. Mas não é a minha tristeza que importa aqui. De certo modo, ele deixou todos vocês tristes, embora eu não queira dizer isso com dureza demais.

am.L: ነገር ግን ማንም አሳዝኖ ከሆነ፣ እኔን አላሳዘነም፤ ነገር ግን ከልክ በላይ እንዳልጫን፣ በከፊል ሁላችሁን [አሳዝኗል]።
am.B: አንድ ሰው ሐዘን አምጥቶ ከሆነ፣ ያሳዘነው እኔን ሳይሆን በከፊል ሁላችሁን ነው (ነገሩን ማክበድ አልፈልግም)።
am.R: አንድ ሰው ሐዘን አምጥቷል። እዚህ ላይ ግን ዋናው ነገር የእኔ ሐዘን አይደለም። በአንዳንድ መንገድ ሁላችሁንም አሳዝኗል፤ ቢሆንም ነገሩን አክርሬ መናገር አልፈልግም።

decisions.choice: he grieved not Paul but, in some measure, all of them; "so that I may not be too severe" is an aside
alternatives: he grieved me only in part, so that I may not lay a burden on all of you
he grieved not only me but in part all of you
decisions.reason: The sentence is compressed. The best reading takes πάντας ὑμᾶς ("all of you") as the ones grieved, with ἀπὸ μέρους ("in part") softening it and the purpose clause as an aside about Paul's own words. Other readings attach "in part" to Paul's own grief, or the purpose clause to the church's burden.

decisions.choice: a particular man in the church, whom Paul does not name
decisions.reason: τις ("anyone") is tactful: Paul has one man in mind (verses 6-7 speak of "such a one"), and 7:12 mentions "the one who did wrong". What he did is not said. Some connect him with the man of 1 Corinthians 5:1-5, but 7:12 suggests a wrong done to a person, perhaps to Paul himself on his painful visit.

decisions.choice: "not me": Paul refuses to treat the offense as a private grievance
alternatives: Paul denies that he was hurt at all
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 show that Paul was deeply grieved. The contrast "not me ... but all of you" means that the wrong touched the whole church, and it is the church's matter to settle.

decisions.choice: to be too heavy: to overstate or be too hard
alternatives: to put a burden on all of you
decisions.reason: ἐπιβαρῶ means to weigh down. Here Paul most likely means he does not want to press the charge too hard, whether against the man or against the church.

decisions.choice: it is not my sadness that matters here
decisions.reason: Readable states the point of Paul's "not me" (m3) so that it does not sound as if Paul felt nothing.

decisions.choice: no quiero cargar demasiado las tintas
decisions.reason: A common Spanish idiom for overstating a matter, which is the sense of the verb here (meaning decision); it keeps the aside short, as the English does in brackets.

decisions.choice: mtu, no gender span
decisions.reason: The offender is one particular man (docs/corinthians-terms.md). Swahili "mtu" and the verb prefix "a-" do not mark gender, so the text needs no span and says no more than the Greek does.

decisions.choice: "người ấy", "người này" for the offender, with no gender span (2:5-8)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: one particular man, with no gender span; Vietnamese "người ấy" is the neutral word, and "hắn" or "kẻ" would make him an enemy just as Paul asks the church to forgive him.

decisions.choice: "그", "그 사람", "이 사람" for the offender, with no gender span, through verses 5-11
decisions.reason: The project's choice: the Greek is masculine and means one particular man.

decisions.choice: the words "so that I may not be too severe" as an aside, in dashes (L) and parentheses (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the words as an aside, uncertain and footnoted.

source.text: ἱκανὸν τῷ τοιούτῳ ἡ ἐπιτιμία αὕτη ἡ ὑπὸ τῶν πλειόνων, ὥστε τοὐναντίον μᾶλλον ὑμᾶς χαρίσασθαι καὶ παρακαλέσαι, μή πως τῇ περισσοτέρᾳ λύπῃ καταποθῇ ὁ τοιοῦτος.

records.literal_gloss: Sufficient for the such [one] the punishment this, the [one] by the majority, \v 7 so that on the contrary rather you to forgive and to comfort, lest somehow by the excessive grief be swallowed up the such [one].

en.L: For such a person this punishment by the majority [is] enough, \v 7 so that on the contrary you should rather forgive and comfort [him], lest somehow such a person be swallowed up by excessive grief.
en.B: The penalty that most of you imposed on this man is enough for him. \v 7 So now you should turn the other way: forgive him and comfort him, or he may be swallowed up by grief that is more than he can bear.
en.R: Most of you have already punished this man, and that is enough. \v 7 Now you should forgive him and comfort him instead. If you do not, he may become so full of sadness that it crushes him.

fr.L: Pour un tel [homme], cette punition [infligée] par la majorité [est] suffisante, \v 7 de sorte qu’au contraire vous devriez plutôt [lui] pardonner et [le] réconforter, de peur qu’un tel [homme] ne soit englouti par une tristesse excessive.
fr.B: La sanction que la plupart d’entre vous ont infligée à cet homme lui suffit. \v 7 Vous devez maintenant faire l’inverse : lui pardonner et le réconforter, sinon il risque d’être englouti par une tristesse plus grande qu’il ne peut supporter.
fr.R: La plupart d’entre vous ont déjà puni cet homme, et cela suffit. \v 7 Maintenant, vous devez plutôt lui pardonner et le réconforter. Sinon, il risque d’être si rempli de tristesse qu’il en sera écrasé.

es.L: Para tal persona basta este castigo [impuesto] por la mayoría, \v 7 de modo que, al contrario, más bien [{{plural_you:deben|debéis}}] perdonar[lo] y consolar[lo], no sea que tal persona sea consumida por una tristeza excesiva.
es.B: La sanción que la mayoría de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} impuso a este hombre ya es suficiente para él. \v 7 Así que ahora {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} hacer lo contrario: {{plural_you:perdónenlo|perdonadlo}} y {{plural_you:consuélenlo|consoladlo}}, no sea que la tristeza lo hunda, una tristeza mayor de la que puede soportar.
es.R: La mayoría de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ya ha castigado a este hombre, y eso basta. \v 7 Ahora, en cambio, {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} perdonarlo y consolarlo. Si no lo {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}, puede llenarse tanto de tristeza que quede aplastado.

sw.L: Adhabu hii iliyotolewa na walio wengi inamtosha mtu kama huyo, \v 7 hivi kwamba kinyume chake ni afadhali ninyi mmsamehe na kumfariji, asije mtu kama huyo akamezwa na huzuni iliyopita kiasi.
sw.B: Adhabu ambayo wengi wenu mlimpa mtu huyu inamtosha. \v 7 Kwa hiyo sasa mgeuke upande mwingine: msameheni na kumfariji, asije akamezwa na huzuni iliyozidi kiasi anachoweza kubeba.
sw.R: Wengi wenu mmekwisha kumwadhibu mtu huyu, na hiyo inatosha. \v 7 Sasa mnapaswa kumsamehe na kumfariji badala yake. Msipofanya hivyo, huzuni yake inaweza kuzidi mpaka ikamlemea kabisa.

vi.L: Hình phạt này do số đông đưa ra là đủ cho người như thế, \v 7 vậy nên trái lại, anh chị em hãy tha thứ và an ủi [người ấy] thì hơn, kẻo người như thế bị nỗi buồn rầu quá mức nuốt mất chăng.
vi.B: Hình phạt mà phần đông anh chị em đã đưa ra cho người này là đủ rồi. \v 7 Vậy bây giờ anh chị em nên làm ngược lại: hãy tha thứ và an ủi người ấy, kẻo người ấy bị nhấn chìm trong nỗi buồn rầu quá sức chịu đựng.
vi.R: Phần đông anh chị em đã phạt người này rồi, và như vậy là đủ. \v 7 Bây giờ anh chị em nên tha thứ và an ủi người ấy. Nếu không, người ấy có thể buồn đến nỗi bị nỗi buồn đè bẹp.

ko.L: 그런 사람에게는 많은 사람에게서 받은 이 벌로 충분합니다. \v 7 그러므로 오히려 여러분은 그를 용서하고 위로해야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 그런 사람이 지나친 슬픔에 삼켜질까 [염려됩니다].
ko.B: 여러분 가운데 대다수가 그 사람에게 내린 벌은 이제 충분합니다. \v 7 그러니 이제는 오히려 그를 용서하고 위로하십시오. 그렇지 않으면 그가 감당할 수 없는 슬픔에 삼켜질지도 모릅니다.
ko.R: 여러분 대부분이 이미 이 사람에게 벌을 주었고, 그것으로 충분합니다. \v 7 이제는 오히려 그를 용서하고 위로해 주십시오. 그렇게 하지 않으면 그는 슬픔이 너무 커서 무너져 버릴지도 모릅니다.

pt.L: Para tal pessoa basta esta punição [aplicada] pela maioria, \v 7 de modo que, pelo contrário, vocês devem antes perdoar e consolar [essa pessoa], para que tal pessoa não seja de algum modo tragada por excessiva tristeza.
pt.B: Para esse homem basta a punição que a maioria de vocês lhe impôs. \v 7 Agora, pelo contrário, vocês devem perdoá-lo e consolá-lo, para que ele não seja tragado por uma tristeza maior do que pode suportar.
pt.R: A maioria de vocês já castigou esse homem, e isso é suficiente. \v 7 Agora vocês devem perdoar esse homem e consolá-lo. Se não fizerem isso, ele pode ficar tão cheio de tristeza que ela vai esmagá-lo.

am.L: ለእንደዚህ ያለው ሰው ይህ በብዙዎቹ የተሰጠው ቅጣት ይበቃዋል፤ \v 7 ስለዚህ እንደዚህ ያለው ሰው በሚበዛ ሐዘን ምናልባት እንዳይዋጥ፣ በተቃራኒው ይልቁንም ይቅር ልትሉትና ልታጽናኑት [ይገባል]።
am.B: አብዛኞቻችሁ በዚህ ሰው ላይ የጣላችሁት ቅጣት ይበቃዋል። \v 7 ስለዚህ አሁን አቅጣጫችሁን ለውጡ፤ ይቅር በሉት፤ አጽናኑትም፤ አለዚያ ከሚችለው በላይ በሆነ ሐዘን ሊዋጥ ይችላል።
am.R: አብዛኞቻችሁ ይህን ሰው ቀጥታችሁታል፤ ያም ይበቃል። \v 7 አሁን ግን ይልቁንም ይቅር በሉት፤ አጽናኑትም። ይህን ባታደርጉ እስኪደቅቅ ድረስ በሐዘን ሊሞላ ይችላል።

decisions.choice: a penalty decided by the church
decisions.reason: ἐπιτιμία is a penalty or punishment. Here it was imposed by "the majority", so it was an act of the church as a body, probably a form of discipline that kept the man at a distance from the fellowship (compare 1 Corinthians 5:4-5).

decisions.choice: the majority: most of the church, not all
decisions.reason: πλειόνων is comparative, "the more", and with the article means the greater number. Not everyone in the church agreed, though Paul does not say whether the rest wanted a lighter or a harsher penalty.

decisions.choice: what should follow now: forgiveness and comfort instead of further punishment
decisions.reason: ὥστε with the infinitives states what ought to follow: since the penalty is enough, the church should now do the opposite. παρακαλέσαι here is to comfort or encourage, not to urge.

decisions.choice: swallowed up: overwhelmed, so that he is lost to despair
decisions.reason: καταποθῇ is to swallow or drink down. Used of grief it means to be overcome by it. Paul fears the man may give up entirely, and be lost to the church; verse 11 adds that Satan would gain by it.

decisions.choice: this man; him
decisions.reason: The Greek speaks of "such a one", a particular man (the word is masculine), so Balanced and Readable say "this man" and "him". No gender setting applies to one specific person.

decisions.choice: so full of sadness that it crushes him
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of being swallowed up (m4).

decisions.choice: un tel [homme] (L)
decisions.reason: French needs a noun after "un tel"; the Greek word is masculine and means one particular man (m2 of verse 5), so Literal supplies "homme" in brackets. No gender setting applies to one specific person.

decisions.choice: tal persona (L); este hombre (B, R), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The Greek is masculine and means one particular man (meaning decision), so, as in the English, there is no gender span; Literal keeps the Greek "such a one" as "tal persona".

decisions.choice: akamezwa na huzuni
decisions.reason: "Kumezwa" (to be swallowed) keeps the Greek picture and is natural in Swahili for being overwhelmed; Readable says "ikamlemea kabisa" (crushes him).

decisions.choice: ሰው (person), with masculine verbs
decisions.reason: The offender is one man; Amharic marks him with masculine verb endings (ይበቃዋል, ይቅር በሉት) and needs no gender setting, as the book's terms note says.

source.text: διὸ παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς κυρῶσαι εἰς αὐτὸν ἀγάπην·

records.literal_gloss: Therefore I urge you to confirm toward him love;

en.L: Therefore I urge you to confirm [your] love for him.
en.B: So I urge you to confirm your love for him openly.
en.R: So I am asking you to show him clearly that you love him.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi je vous exhorte à confirmer envers lui [votre] amour.
fr.B: Je vous demande donc instamment de lui confirmer ouvertement votre amour.
fr.R: Alors je vous demande de lui montrer clairement que vous l’aimez.

es.L: Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} ruego que {{plural_you:confirmen|confirméis}} [{{plural_you:su|vuestro}}] amor hacia él.
es.B: Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} ruego que {{plural_you:confirmen|confirméis}} públicamente {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} amor por él.
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:les|os}} pido que le {{plural_you:muestren|mostréis}} claramente que lo {{plural_you:aman|amáis}}.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nawasihi mthibitishe upendo [wenu] kwake.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nawasihi mthibitishe wazi upendo wenu kwake.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nawaomba mumwonyeshe waziwazi kwamba mnampenda.

vi.L: Vì vậy, tôi nài khuyên anh chị em xác nhận tình yêu thương [của anh chị em] đối với người ấy.
vi.B: Vì vậy, tôi nài khuyên anh chị em hãy công khai xác nhận tình yêu thương của anh chị em đối với người ấy.
vi.R: Vì vậy, tôi xin anh chị em hãy cho người ấy thấy rõ rằng anh chị em yêu thương người ấy.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 여러분에게 권합니다. 그에게 [여러분의] 사랑을 확증하십시오.
ko.B: 그러므로 여러분에게 권합니다. 그에 대한 여러분의 사랑을 공개적으로 확인해 주십시오.
ko.R: 그러니 여러분에게 부탁합니다. 여러분이 그를 사랑한다는 것을 그에게 분명히 보여 주십시오.

pt.L: Por isso exorto vocês a confirmarem [o] amor por ele.
pt.B: Por isso eu lhes peço com insistência que confirmem abertamente o amor que vocês têm por ele.
pt.R: Por isso estou pedindo que vocês mostrem claramente a ele que vocês o amam.

am.L: ስለዚህ ለእርሱ ያላችሁን ፍቅር እንድታጸኑ እለምናችኋለሁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ለእርሱ ያላችሁን ፍቅር በግልጽ እንድታረጋግጡ እለምናችኋለሁ።

decisions.choice: to confirm publicly, as by a formal decision
decisions.reason: κυρῶσαι is a legal word: to ratify or make valid. The church had acted together in punishing the man (verse 6); Paul asks them to act together again and make their love for him plain and official.

decisions.choice: I urge: a strong request
decisions.reason: παρακαλῶ is the same verb as "comfort" in verse 7, but with an infinitive it means to urge or appeal.

decisions.choice: confirm ... openly (B); show him clearly (R)
decisions.reason: "Ratify" is too formal for most readers. Balanced keeps "confirm" and adds "openly" for the public side of the word (m1); Readable says "show him clearly".

decisions.choice: je vous exhorte (L); je vous demande instamment (B); je vous demande (R)
decisions.reason: This is the verb rendered "réconforter" in 1:3-7 and 2:7, but here it is a strong request (m2), so French uses the words for asking, as the English "urge" does.

decisions.choice: nawasihi
decisions.reason: "Kusihi" is to plead earnestly, a strong request, which is the sense of the verb here (meaning decision); Readable uses the plainer "nawaomba".

source.text: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ καὶ ἔγραψα ἵνα γνῶ τὴν δοκιμὴν ὑμῶν, εἰ εἰς πάντα ὑπήκοοί ἐστε.

records.literal_gloss: For to this for also I wrote, so that I might know the proof of you, whether in all things obedient you are.

en.L: For to this end also I wrote, so that I might know your proven character, whether you are obedient in everything.
en.B: For this was another purpose of my writing: to learn whether you would prove yourselves true, obedient in every matter.
en.R: I also wrote to you for another reason. I wanted to see if you would show that you are true and obey in every way.

fr.L: Car c’est aussi dans ce but que j’ai écrit : afin de connaître votre valeur éprouvée, [de savoir] si vous êtes obéissants en tout.
fr.B: Car je vous ai écrit aussi dans un autre but : savoir si vous feriez la preuve de ce que vous valez, en obéissant en toutes choses.
fr.R: Je vous ai aussi écrit pour une autre raison. Je voulais voir si vous alliez montrer ce que vous valez vraiment, et que vous obéissez en tout.

es.L: Porque también para esto escribí: para conocer {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} prueba, si {{plural_you:son|sois}} obedientes en todo.
es.B: Ese fue otro propósito de mi carta: saber si {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:demostrarían|demostraríais}} ser auténticos, obedientes en todo.
es.R: También {{plural_you:les|os}} escribí por otra razón. Quería ver si {{plural_you:mostrarían|mostraríais}} que {{plural_you:son|sois}} auténticos y {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} en todo.

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa ajili ya hili pia niliandika, ili nijue uthabiti wenu, kama mnatii katika mambo yote.
sw.B: Kwa maana hili lilikuwa kusudi lingine la kuandika kwangu: kujua kama mtajithibitisha kuwa wa kweli, mkitii katika kila jambo.
sw.R: Niliwaandikia pia kwa sababu nyingine. Nilitaka kuona kama mtaonyesha kwamba ninyi ni wa kweli na kwamba mnatii kwa kila namna.

vi.L: Vì cũng vì mục đích này mà tôi đã viết, để tôi biết phẩm chất đã qua thử thách của anh chị em, xem anh chị em có vâng phục trong mọi sự không.
vi.B: Tôi viết thư cũng vì một mục đích khác: để biết anh chị em có tỏ ra chân thật, vâng phục trong mọi việc hay không.
vi.R: Tôi cũng viết cho anh chị em vì một lý do khác. Tôi muốn xem anh chị em có cho thấy mình chân thật và vâng phục trong mọi việc không.

ko.L: 내가 [전에] 쓴 것도 이 때문이었습니다. 여러분이 모든 일에 순종하는지 여러분의 인정받은 모습을 알려는 것이었습니다.
ko.B: 내가 편지를 쓴 데에는 또 다른 목적도 있었습니다. 여러분이 모든 일에 순종하여 참된 사람으로 드러나는지 알고 싶었습니다.
ko.R: 내가 편지를 쓴 데에는 또 다른 이유도 있었습니다. 여러분이 진실한 사람들이며 모든 일에 순종한다는 것을 보여 주는지 알고 싶었습니다.

pt.L: Pois para isto também escrevi, para conhecer a prova de vocês, se vocês são obedientes em tudo.
pt.B: Pois este foi outro propósito da minha carta: saber se vocês passariam pela prova, obedecendo em todas as coisas.
pt.R: Também escrevi a vocês por outro motivo. Eu queria ver se vocês iam mostrar que são verdadeiros e obedecer em tudo.

am.L: ለዚህም ደግሞ ጻፍኩ፤ በሁሉ ነገር ታዛዦች እንደ ሆናችሁ የተፈተነ ማንነታችሁን አውቅ ዘንድ ነው።
am.B: የጻፍኩበት ሌላው ምክንያት ይህ ነው፤ እውነተኞች መሆናችሁን አረጋግጣችሁ በነገር ሁሉ ትታዘዙ እንደ ሆነ ለማወቅ ነው።
am.R: የጻፍኩላችሁ ለሌላም ምክንያት ነው። እውነተኞች መሆናችሁን አሳይታችሁ በሁሉም መንገድ ትታዘዙ እንደ ሆነ ለማየት ፈለግኩ።

decisions.choice: "to this end" points forward to the purpose that follows; "also" adds it to the purpose of verse 4
alternatives: "to this end" points back to verses 6-8
decisions.reason: εἰς τοῦτο is completed by the clause with ἵνα ("so that"). The καὶ ("also") shows a second purpose of the same letter, besides showing his love (verse 4).

decisions.choice: proven character: what they are shown to be when tested
decisions.reason: δοκιμὴν is the quality that testing brings to light, like metal proved in the fire. Paul uses the word again in 8:2 and 9:13.

decisions.choice: obedient to the instructions Paul gave as Christ's apostle
alternatives: obedient to Paul as a person
decisions.reason: Paul is not asking for personal loyalty but for obedience to what he wrote in Christ's name. 7:15 says that they received Titus "with fear and trembling" and obeyed; 10:6 speaks of their obedience being complete.

decisions.choice: prove yourselves true (B); show that you are true (R)
decisions.reason: "Proof" is unclear in English; Balanced and Readable say what is being proved.

decisions.choice: uthabiti (L); kujithibitisha (B); kuonyesha (R)
decisions.reason: The word is what a person is shown to be when tested (meaning decision). "Uthabiti" and "kujithibitisha" come from "-thibitika" (to be proven), the root used for this word family in Romans 5:4, so it can be traced when the word returns (8:2; 9:13; 13:3).

decisions.choice: "phẩm chất đã qua thử thách" (L) for dokime
decisions.reason: The Literal phrase of the Vietnamese Romans 5:4 and Philippians 2:22 for the same word; the dokimos family returns in 8:2, 9:13 and 13:3-7.

decisions.choice: "인정받은 모습" (L) for the proven character, of the word family of 1 Corinthians 11:19 and 2 Corinthians 13:3-7
decisions.reason: The project keeps this family visible: "인정받다" for being approved, here with "모습" for the character shown.

decisions.choice: se vocês passariam pela prova
decisions.reason: The Corinthians terms keep the family of this word visible as "prova", "aprovado" (10:18; 13:3-7). Portuguese "passar pela prova" says what m2 says, character shown by testing, and keeps the family; Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

source.text: ᾧ δέ τι χαρίζεσθε, κἀγώ· καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ ὃ κεχάρισμαι, εἴ τι κεχάρισμαι, δι’ ὑμᾶς ἐν προσώπῳ Χριστοῦ, ἵνα μὴ πλεονεκτηθῶμεν ὑπὸ τοῦ Σατανᾶ, οὐ γὰρ αὐτοῦ τὰ νοήματα ἀγνοοῦμεν.

records.literal_gloss: To whom but anything you forgive, I also; for indeed I, what I have forgiven, if anything I have forgiven, [it is] because of you in [the] face of Christ, \v 11 so that not we may be taken advantage of by the Satan, for not of him the designs we are ignorant of.

en.L: Now to whomever you forgive anything, I also [forgive]; for indeed what I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, [I have forgiven] for your sake in [the] presence of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 11 so that we may not be taken advantage of by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs.
en.B: If you forgive anyone anything, I forgive that person too. For whatever I have forgiven, so far as I have had anything to forgive, I have forgiven for your sake, in the presence of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, \v 11 so that Satan does not gain the advantage over us. We know well enough what he has in mind.
en.R: If you forgive someone, I forgive that person too. Whatever I have forgiven, if there was anything to forgive at all, I forgave for your sake, with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} watching. \v 11 We do not want Satan to get the better of us. We know the tricks he plans.

fr.L: Or à qui vous pardonnez quelque chose, moi aussi [je pardonne] ; car moi aussi, ce que j’ai pardonné, si j’ai pardonné quelque chose, [je l’ai fait] à cause de vous, en présence du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, \v 11 afin que nous ne soyons pas exploités par Satan, car nous n’ignorons pas ses desseins.
fr.B: Si vous pardonnez quelque chose à quelqu’un, je lui pardonne moi aussi. Et ce que j’ai pardonné, si j’avais quelque chose à pardonner, je l’ai pardonné à cause de vous, en présence du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, \v 11 pour que Satan ne prenne pas l’avantage sur nous. Nous savons bien ce qu’il a en tête.
fr.R: Si vous pardonnez à quelqu’un, je lui pardonne moi aussi. Ce que j’ai pardonné, s’il y avait vraiment quelque chose à pardonner, je l’ai pardonné à cause de vous, sous le regard du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. \v 11 Nous ne voulons pas que Satan soit plus fort que nous. Nous connaissons les ruses qu’il prépare.

es.L: Y a quien {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:perdonan|perdonáis}} algo, yo también; porque lo que yo he perdonado, si algo he perdonado, [lo he perdonado] por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en presencia [de] {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, \v 11 para que no seamos engañados por Satanás, porque no ignoramos sus intenciones.
es.B: Si {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:perdonan|perdonáis}} algo a alguien, yo también perdono a esa persona. Porque lo que yo he perdonado, en la medida en que haya tenido algo que perdonar, lo he perdonado por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, en presencia {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, \v 11 para que Satanás no saque ventaja de nosotros. Bien sabemos lo que él se propone.
es.R: Si {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:perdonan|perdonáis}} a alguien, yo también perdono a esa persona. Lo que yo he perdonado, si es que había algo que perdonar, lo perdoné por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} como testigo. \v 11 No queremos que Satanás nos gane la partida. Conocemos los engaños que planea.

sw.L: Basi yeyote mnayemsamehe jambo lolote, mimi pia [namsamehe]; kwa maana kweli nilichosamehe, ikiwa nimesamehe kitu chochote, [nimesamehe] kwa ajili yenu mbele ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 11 ili tusidanganywe na Shetani; kwa maana hatukosi kujua hila zake.
sw.B: Mkimsamehe mtu yeyote jambo lolote, mimi pia namsamehe. Kwa maana chochote nilichosamehe, ikiwa kulikuwa na kitu cha kunisamehe, nimekisamehe kwa ajili yenu, mbele ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 11 ili Shetani asipate nafasi ya kutushinda. Tunajua vizuri anachokipanga.
sw.R: Mkimsamehe mtu, mimi pia namsamehe. Chochote nilichosamehe, kama kulikuwa na kitu chochote cha kusamehe, nilisamehe kwa ajili yenu, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} akiwa anaona. \v 11 Hatutaki Shetani atushinde kwa ujanja. Tunazijua hila anazozipanga.

vi.L: Người nào anh chị em tha thứ điều gì, thì tôi cũng [tha thứ]; vì thật ra điều tôi đã tha thứ, nếu tôi đã có tha thứ điều gì, [thì tôi đã tha thứ] vì anh chị em, trước mặt {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, \v 11 để chúng ta không bị Sa-tan lợi dụng; vì chúng ta không phải không biết các mưu kế của nó.
vi.B: Nếu anh chị em tha thứ cho ai điều gì, thì tôi cũng tha thứ cho người ấy. Vì điều gì tôi đã tha thứ, nếu tôi có điều gì để tha thứ, thì tôi đã tha thứ vì anh chị em, trước mặt {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, \v 11 để Sa-tan không thắng thế được chúng ta. Chúng ta biết rõ những mưu kế của nó.
vi.R: Nếu anh chị em tha thứ cho ai, thì tôi cũng tha thứ cho người ấy. Điều gì tôi đã tha thứ, nếu thật có điều gì cần tha thứ, thì tôi đã tha thứ vì anh chị em, và có {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} chứng kiến. \v 11 Chúng ta không muốn Sa-tan thắng chúng ta. Chúng ta biết những mưu mẹo nó đang toan tính.

ko.L: 여러분이 무엇이든지 용서하는 사람이면 나도 [용서합니다]. 내가 용서한 것이 있다면, 내가 용서한 것은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 앞에서 여러분을 위하여 [용서한 것입니다]. \v 11 이는 우리가 사탄에게 속지 않게 하려는 것입니다. 우리는 그의 계략을 모르지 않습니다.
ko.B: 여러분이 누구를 무슨 일로 용서하든지, 나도 그 사람을 용서합니다. 내가 용서할 것이 있었다면, 내가 용서한 것은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 앞에서 여러분을 위해 용서한 것입니다. \v 11 그것은 사탄이 우리를 이용하지 못하게 하려는 것입니다. 우리는 사탄이 무엇을 꾀하는지 잘 압니다.
ko.R: 여러분이 누구를 용서하면 나도 그 사람을 용서합니다. 내가 용서할 것이 있었다면, 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 지켜보시는 앞에서 여러분을 위해 그를 용서했습니다. \v 11 우리는 사탄이 우리를 이기는 것을 원하지 않습니다. 우리는 사탄이 꾸미는 속임수를 압니다.

pt.L: Ora, a quem vocês perdoam alguma coisa, eu também [perdoo]; pois de fato o que eu perdoei, se perdoei alguma coisa, [perdoei] por causa de vocês na presença {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, \v 11 para que não sejamos explorados por Satanás; pois não ignoramos os seus desígnios.
pt.B: Se vocês perdoam alguém de alguma coisa, eu também perdoo essa pessoa. Pois aquilo que perdoei, se é que eu tinha alguma coisa para perdoar, perdoei por causa de vocês, na presença {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, \v 11 para que Satanás não leve vantagem sobre nós. Conhecemos bem o que ele tem em mente.
pt.R: Se vocês perdoarem alguém, eu também perdoo essa pessoa. Tudo o que perdoei, se havia mesmo alguma coisa para perdoar, perdoei por causa de vocês, sob o olhar {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}. \v 11 Não queremos que Satanás leve a melhor sobre nós. Conhecemos os truques que ele planeja.

am.L: እናንተ አንዳች ይቅር የምትሉትን እኔ ደግሞ [ይቅር እላለሁ]፤ እኔም ይቅር ያልኩት፣ አንዳች ይቅር ያልኩት ቢኖር፣ ስለ እናንተ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ፊት [ይቅር ያልኩት] ነውና፤ \v 11 ይህም ሰይጣን እንዳያታልለን ነው፤ ሐሳቡን አንስተውምና።
am.B: እናንተ ለማንም ስለ ማንኛውም ነገር ይቅር ብትሉ፣ እኔም ያንን ሰው ይቅር እላለሁ። ይቅር ያልኩት ነገር ቢኖር፣ ይቅር የምለው ነገር እስካለ ድረስ፣ ስለ እናንተ ስል {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ፊት ይቅር ብያለሁ፤ \v 11 ይህም ሰይጣን በእኛ ላይ ብልጫ እንዳያገኝ ነው። እርሱ ምን እንደሚያስብ በሚገባ እናውቃለንና።
am.R: እናንተ አንድን ሰው ይቅር ብትሉ እኔም ያንን ሰው ይቅር እላለሁ። ይቅር የምለው ነገር ጭራሽ ካለ፣ ይቅር ያልኩት ስለ እናንተ ስል {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} እያየ ነው። \v 11 ሰይጣን እንዲያሸንፈን አንፈልግም። የሚያሴረውን ተንኮል እናውቃለንና።

decisions.choice: Paul joins in the church's forgiveness
alternatives: Paul forgives only after the church does
decisions.reason: κἀγώ ("I also") leaves the verb to be supplied: whomever they forgive, Paul forgives too. He does not stand apart from the church or hold back his own forgiveness.

decisions.choice: "if I have forgiven anything" plays down Paul's own injury
alternatives: doubt about whether he has forgiven
decisions.reason: Paul does not doubt that he has forgiven. As in verse 5, he will not make the offense a matter of his own hurt.

decisions.choice: in the presence of Christ, who sees and is witness
alternatives: as Christ's representative, acting in his person
decisions.reason: προσώπῳ ("face") after "in" usually means "before, in the sight of" someone. Paul forgives with Christ looking on, as one who answers to him (compare 2:17; 4:2). The phrase could also mean that he forgives in Christ's name, as his representative.

decisions.choice: Satan, the adversary, would gain from an unforgiving church
alternatives: a general warning with no link to this case
decisions.reason: Σατανᾶ is the adversary of God's people. If the church kept the man out for good, or quarreled over him, Satan would have the advantage: a believer lost to despair (verse 7) and a church divided. πλεονεκτηθῶμεν is to be taken advantage of, cheated of something.

decisions.choice: his designs: Satan's schemes and purposes
decisions.reason: νοήματα are thoughts or plans. Paul uses the word of minds that Satan blinds (3:14; 4:4) and of plots that must be taken captive (10:5; 11:3); here they are Satan's own designs.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: that person
decisions.reason: The Greek is general ("to whomever"), so Balanced and Readable say "that person", which needs no gender setting.

decisions.choice: with Christ watching
decisions.reason: Readable states the sense chosen in m3.

decisions.choice: hatukosi kujua hila zake
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek understatement, "we are not ignorant of", with "hatukosi kujua" (we do not fail to know); Balanced and Readable say it positively, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Sa-tan", with "nó" for Satan; "chúng ta" in 2:11
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Ephesians 2:2 and 2 Timothy 2:26, the devil is "nó". Paul includes the church in the danger, so "chúng ta".

source.text: Ἐλθὼν δὲ εἰς τὴν Τρῳάδα εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ θύρας μοι ἀνεῳγμένης ἐν κυρίῳ, οὐκ ἔσχηκα ἄνεσιν τῷ πνεύματί μου τῷ μὴ εὑρεῖν με Τίτον τὸν ἀδελφόν μου, ἀλλὰ ἀποταξάμενος αὐτοῖς ἐξῆλθον εἰς Μακεδονίαν.

records.literal_gloss: Having come but to the Troas for the gospel of the Christ, and a door to me having been opened in [the] Lord, \v 13 not I have had rest in the spirit of me by the not to find me Titus the brother of me, but having said farewell to them I went out to Macedonia.

en.L: Now when I came to Troas for the gospel of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, and a door had been opened for me in [the] Lord, \v 13 I had no relief in my spirit, because I did not find Titus my brother; but saying farewell to them, I went out to Macedonia.
en.B: When I came to Troas for the gospel of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, I found a door standing open for me in the Lord's work. \v 13 Even so, my spirit could not settle, because Titus my brother was nowhere to be found. So I took leave of the believers there and set out for Macedonia.
en.R: I went to the city of Troas to tell people the good news about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. The Lord had made a way for me to do {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} work there. \v 13 But I was restless and worried, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I left the believers in Troas and traveled on to Macedonia.

fr.L: Or, étant venu à Troas pour l’Évangile du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et une porte m’ayant été ouverte dans le Seigneur, \v 13 je n’ai pas eu de repos dans mon esprit, parce que je n’ai pas trouvé Tite, mon frère ; mais, ayant pris congé d’eux, je suis parti pour la Macédoine.
fr.B: Quand je suis arrivé à Troas pour l’Évangile du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, j’ai trouvé une porte ouverte pour moi dans l’œuvre du Seigneur. \v 13 Pourtant, mon esprit n’a pas trouvé de repos, parce que Tite, mon frère, n’était nulle part. J’ai donc pris congé des croyants de là-bas et je suis parti pour la Macédoine.
fr.R: Je suis allé dans la ville de Troas pour annoncer aux gens la bonne nouvelle du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Le Seigneur m’avait ouvert un chemin pour faire {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} travail là-bas. \v 13 Mais je n’étais pas tranquille, j’étais inquiet, parce que je n’ai pas trouvé mon frère Tite. Alors j’ai quitté les croyants de Troas et j’ai continué mon voyage vers la Macédoine.

es.L: Y cuando llegué a Troas para el evangelio del {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, y se me había abierto una puerta en [el] Señor, \v 13 no tuve descanso en mi espíritu, por no encontrar a Tito, mi hermano; sino que, despidiéndome de ellos, salí hacia Macedonia.
es.B: Cuando llegué a Troas para anunciar el evangelio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, encontré una puerta abierta para mí en la obra del Señor. \v 13 Aun así, mi espíritu no encontraba sosiego, porque no hallé a mi hermano Tito. Así que me despedí de los creyentes de allí y partí hacia Macedonia.
es.R: Fui a la ciudad de Troas para anunciar la buena noticia acerca {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. El Señor me había dado la oportunidad de hacer {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} obra allí. \v 13 Pero yo estaba inquieto y preocupado, porque no encontré allí a mi hermano Tito. Así que me despedí de los creyentes de Troas y seguí mi viaje a Macedonia.

sw.L: Basi nilipofika Troa kwa ajili ya Injili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na mlango ukiwa umefunguliwa kwangu katika Bwana, \v 13 sikupata utulivu katika roho yangu, kwa sababu sikumkuta Tito ndugu yangu; bali nikiwaaga, nikaondoka kwenda Makedonia.
sw.B: Nilipofika Troa kwa ajili ya Injili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, nilikuta mlango umefunguliwa kwa ajili yangu katika kazi ya Bwana. \v 13 Hata hivyo, roho yangu haikutulia, kwa sababu sikumwona Tito ndugu yangu popote. Kwa hiyo niliwaaga waamini wa huko, nikaondoka kwenda Makedonia.
sw.R: Nilikwenda katika mji wa Troa kuwaambia watu Habari Njema kuhusu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Bwana alikuwa amenifungulia njia ya kufanya kazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} huko. \v 13 Lakini sikuwa na amani, nilikuwa na wasiwasi, kwa sababu sikumkuta ndugu yangu Tito huko. Kwa hiyo niliwaacha waamini wa Troa, nikasafiri kwenda Makedonia.

vi.L: Khi tôi đến Trô-ách vì Tin Lành của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, và một cánh cửa đã mở ra cho tôi trong Chúa, \v 13 tâm linh tôi không được yên nghỉ vì tôi không tìm thấy Tít, người anh em của tôi; nhưng từ giã họ, tôi đi đến Ma-xê-đoan.
vi.B: Khi tôi đến Trô-ách để rao giảng Tin Lành của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, tôi thấy một cánh cửa đã mở sẵn cho tôi trong công việc của Chúa. \v 13 Dù vậy, tâm linh tôi vẫn không yên, vì không tìm thấy Tít, người anh em của tôi, ở đâu cả. Vì vậy, tôi từ giã các tín hữu ở đó và lên đường đi Ma-xê-đoan.
vi.R: Tôi đến thành Trô-ách để rao báo Tin Lành về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Chúa đã mở đường cho tôi làm công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở đó. \v 13 Nhưng tôi bồn chồn lo lắng, vì không tìm thấy Tít, người anh em của tôi, ở đó. Vì vậy, tôi từ giã các tín hữu ở Trô-ách và đi tiếp đến Ma-xê-đoan.

ko.L: 내가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 복음을 [전하려고] 드로아에 갔을 때, 주님 안에서 나에게 문이 열렸지만, \v 13 내 형제 디도를 만나지 못해서 내 영이 편하지 않았습니다. 그래서 나는 그들과 작별하고 마게도냐로 떠났습니다.
ko.B: 내가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 복음을 전하려고 드로아에 갔을 때, 주님께서 나에게 일할 수 있는 문을 열어 주셨습니다. \v 13 그런데도 내 형제 디도를 만나지 못해서 내 마음이 편하지 않았습니다. 그래서 나는 그곳 신자들과 작별하고 마게도냐로 떠났습니다.
ko.R: 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}에 대한 기쁜 소식을 전하려고 드로아라는 도시에 갔습니다. 주님께서는 내가 그곳에서 그분의 일을 할 수 있는 길을 열어 주셨습니다. \v 13 그러나 내 형제 디도를 그곳에서 만나지 못해서 나는 마음이 놓이지 않고 걱정이 되었습니다. 그래서 나는 드로아의 신자들과 작별하고 마게도냐로 계속 여행했습니다.

pt.L: Ora, quando cheguei a Trôade para o evangelho do {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, e uma porta tinha sido aberta para mim no Senhor, \v 13 não tive descanso no meu espírito, por não ter encontrado Tito, meu irmão; mas, despedindo-me deles, parti para a Macedônia.
pt.B: Quando cheguei a Trôade por causa do evangelho {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, encontrei uma porta aberta para mim na obra do Senhor. \v 13 Mesmo assim, o meu espírito não teve sossego, porque não encontrei ali o meu irmão Tito. Por isso me despedi dos irmãos de lá e parti para a Macedônia.
pt.R: Fui para a cidade de Trôade para contar às pessoas as boas-novas a respeito {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}. O Senhor tinha aberto um caminho para eu fazer o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trabalho ali. \v 13 Mas eu estava inquieto e preocupado, porque não encontrei ali o meu irmão Tito. Então me despedi dos irmãos de Trôade e segui viagem para a Macedônia.

am.L: ስለ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ወንጌልም ወደ ጢሮአዳ በመጣኩ ጊዜ፣ በጌታ በር ተከፍቶልኝ ሳለ፣ \v 13 ወንድሜን ቲቶን ስላላገኘኩት በመንፈሴ ዕረፍት አላገኘኩም፤ ነገር ግን እነርሱን ተሰናብቼ ወደ መቄዶንያ ወጣኩ።
am.B: ስለ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ወንጌል ወደ ጢሮአዳ በመጣኩ ጊዜ፣ በጌታ ሥራ በር ተከፍቶልኝ አገኘኩ። \v 13 ይሁን እንጂ ወንድሜ ቲቶ በዚያ ስላልተገኘ መንፈሴ ዕረፍት አላገኘም። ስለዚህ በዚያ ያሉትን አማኞች ተሰናብቼ ወደ መቄዶንያ ሄድኩ።
am.R: ስለ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} የምሥራች ለሰዎች ለመንገር ወደ ጢሮአዳ ከተማ ሄድኩ። ጌታ በዚያ ሥራውን እንድሠራ መንገድ ከፍቶልኝ ነበር። \v 13 ነገር ግን ወንድሜን ቲቶን በዚያ ስላላገኘኩት ዕረፍት አጣኩ፤ ተጨነቅኩም። ስለዚህ በጢሮአዳ ያሉትን አማኞች ትቼ ወደ መቄዶንያ ተጓዝኩ።

decisions.choice: Troas, Titus and Macedonia: Paul's journey while waiting for news from Corinth
decisions.reason: Troas was a port on the northwest coast of Asia Minor, where travelers crossed by sea to Macedonia (Acts 16:8-11; 20:5-12). Titus, Paul's co-worker, had gone to Corinth and was to bring news of how the church took Paul's letter. Paul breaks off the story here and takes it up again in 7:5-7, where Titus at last meets him in Macedonia.

decisions.choice: an open door: an opportunity to preach, given by the Lord
decisions.reason: Paul uses the same picture in 1 Corinthians 16:9 and Colossians 4:3. "In the Lord" says whose work it was and who opened the door.

decisions.choice: the gospel about Christ, to preach it
decisions.reason: Paul came to Troas "for" the gospel, that is, to proclaim it. The gospel "of Christ" is the good news about him.

decisions.choice: my spirit: Paul's inner self
decisions.reason: πνεύματί with "my" is Paul's own spirit, his inner life. In 7:5 he says the same of his "flesh": he had no rest, inside or out.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article: "the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}".

decisions.choice: the believers
decisions.reason: "Them" has no stated antecedent; it means the people at Troas, who from the open door were believers.

decisions.choice: The Lord had made a way for me to do his work there
alternatives: a door had been opened for me in the Lord
decisions.reason: Readable explains the open door (m2).

decisions.choice: l’Évangile (L, B); la bonne nouvelle (R) (for the whole book)
alternatives: la bonne nouvelle at every level
decisions.reason: As in Colossians and the style guide: Readable says "bonne nouvelle" because "Évangile" is church language; the capital marks the message itself.

decisions.choice: Injili (L, B); Habari Njema (R)
decisions.reason: As in Romans 1:1: "Injili" is the church's word for the gospel and is kept at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "Habari Njema", as the English Readable says "good news".

decisions.choice: "Trô-ách", "Tít", "Ma-xê-đoan"
decisions.reason: The names in the Protestant transliterations; "Tít" is the form of the Vietnamese Galatians 2:1 and the letter to Titus.

decisions.choice: "드로아", "디도" in their Protestant Korean forms; "내 영" (L), "내 마음" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Names as the style guide asks. The meaning decision reads "my spirit" as Paul's inner self; Balanced and Readable say "마음" (heart, mind), the everyday word for it.

decisions.choice: o evangelho (L, B); as boas-novas (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as the style guide sets it: "evangelho" is the word Brazilian readers know for the message Paul preaches, and Balanced keeps it as the English keeps "gospel"; Readable says "as boas-novas", as the English Readable says "good news".

decisions.choice: os irmãos de lá (B); os irmãos de Trôade (R)
decisions.reason: Where the English supplies "the believers", Portuguese says "os irmãos", the ordinary church word for fellow believers. "Os crentes" is avoided because in Brazil it names evangelicals as a group.

source.text: Τῷ δὲ θεῷ χάρις τῷ πάντοτε θριαμβεύοντι ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ καὶ τὴν ὀσμὴν τῆς γνώσεως αὐτοῦ φανεροῦντι δι’ ἡμῶν ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ·

records.literal_gloss: To the but God thanks, the [one] always leading in triumph us in the Christ and the fragrance of the knowledge of him making manifest through us in every place;

en.L: But thanks [be] to God, who always leads us in triumph in the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} and makes manifest through us the fragrance of the knowledge of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in every place.
en.B: But thanks be to God, who in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} always leads us along in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} triumphal procession, and who through us makes known in every place the fragrance that is the knowledge of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: But we thank God! Because we are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, God always leads us along in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} victory parade, like people {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has conquered. And everywhere we go, God uses us to spread the knowledge of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, like a sweet smell that fills the air.

fr.L: Mais grâce [soit rendue] à Dieu, qui toujours nous mène en triomphe dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et qui manifeste par nous, en tout lieu, le parfum de la connaissance de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Mais grâce soit rendue à Dieu, qui, {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, nous emmène toujours dans le cortège de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} triomphe, et qui, par nous, fait connaître en tout lieu ce parfum qu’est la connaissance de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Mais nous remercions Dieu ! Parce que nous sommes unis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, Dieu nous emmène toujours avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} défilé de victoire, comme des gens qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a vaincus. Et partout où nous allons, Dieu se sert de nous pour répandre la connaissance du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, comme une bonne odeur qui remplit l’air.

es.L: Pero gracias [sean] a Dios, que siempre nos lleva en triunfo en el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, y por medio de nosotros manifiesta en todo lugar la fragancia de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} conocimiento.
es.B: Pero gracias a Dios, que en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} siempre nos lleva en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} desfile triunfal, y por medio de nosotros da a conocer en todo lugar la fragancia que es el conocimiento de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: ¡Pero damos gracias a Dios! Porque estamos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}, Dios siempre nos lleva en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} desfile de victoria, como personas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha conquistado. Y dondequiera que vamos, Dios nos usa para extender el conocimiento {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, como un perfume agradable que llena el aire.

sw.L: Lakini shukrani [ziwe] kwa Mungu, ambaye siku zote hutuongoza katika maandamano ya ushindi katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na kupitia sisi hudhihirisha kila mahali harufu ya kumfahamu.
sw.B: Lakini Mungu ashukuriwe! Katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hutuongoza siku zote katika maandamano {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya ushindi, na kupitia sisi hueneza kila mahali harufu nzuri, yaani kumfahamu.
sw.R: Lakini tumshukuru Mungu! Kwa kuwa tumeunganishwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mungu hutuongoza siku zote katika maandamano {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya ushindi, kama watu aliowashinda. Na kila mahali tunapokwenda, Mungu anatutumia kueneza habari za kumjua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, kama harufu nzuri inayojaa hewani.

vi.L: Nhưng tạ ơn Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng luôn luôn dẫn chúng tôi trong cuộc diễn hành chiến thắng trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, và qua chúng tôi bày tỏ hương thơm của sự hiểu biết về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở khắp mọi nơi.
vi.B: Nhưng tạ ơn Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng luôn luôn dẫn chúng tôi đi trong cuộc diễn hành chiến thắng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, và qua chúng tôi làm cho hương thơm của sự hiểu biết về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lan tỏa khắp mọi nơi.
vi.R: Nhưng chúng tôi cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời! Vì chúng tôi gắn bó với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, Đức Chúa Trời luôn dẫn chúng tôi đi trong cuộc diễn hành chiến thắng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chinh phục. Và khắp nơi chúng tôi đến, Đức Chúa Trời dùng chúng tôi để làm cho sự hiểu biết về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} lan ra, như một mùi thơm tỏa khắp không gian.

ko.L: 그러나 하나님께 감사를 [드립니다]. 그분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 언제나 우리를 이끌어 개선 행렬에 세우시고, 우리를 통하여 모든 곳에 그분을 아는 지식의 향기를 드러내십니다.
ko.B: 그러나 하나님께 감사드립니다. 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 언제나 우리를 그분의 개선 행렬 가운데 이끌고 가시며, 우리를 통해 모든 곳에 그분을 아는 지식의 향기를 퍼뜨리십니다.
ko.R: 그러나 우리는 하나님께 감사드립니다! 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 하나가 되었기 때문에, 하나님께서는 언제나 그분이 이기신 사람들처럼 우리를 그분의 승리 행렬 가운데 이끌고 가십니다. 그리고 우리가 가는 곳마다 하나님께서는 우리를 사용하셔서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 아는 지식을 퍼뜨리십니다. 그것은 공기를 가득 채우는 좋은 향기와 같습니다.

pt.L: Mas graças [sejam] a Deus, que sempre nos conduz em triunfo no {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} e manifesta por meio de nós o perfume do conhecimento {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} em todo lugar.
pt.B: Mas graças a Deus, que {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} sempre nos leva no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} desfile triunfal e que, por meio de nós, torna conhecido em todo lugar o perfume que é o conhecimento {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.R: Mas nós agradecemos a Deus! Porque estamos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}, Deus sempre nos leva no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} desfile de vitória, como pessoas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} venceu. E, por onde passamos, Deus nos usa para espalhar o conhecimento {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, como um perfume agradável que enche o ar.

am.L: ነገር ግን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ሁልጊዜ በድል ሰልፍ ለሚመራን፣ የእርሱንም የእውቀት ሽታ በየስፍራው ሁሉ በእኛ በኩል ለሚገልጥ ለእግዚአብሔር ምስጋና [ይሁን]።
am.B: ነገር ግን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ሁልጊዜ በድል ሰልፉ ለሚመራን፣ የእርሱም እውቀት የሆነውን መዓዛ በእኛ በኩል በየስፍራው ሁሉ ለሚያሳውቅ ለእግዚአብሔር ምስጋና ይሁን።
am.R: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔርን እናመሰግናለን! ከ{{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ጋር አንድ ስለ ሆንን፣ እግዚአብሔር እንዳሸነፋቸው ሰዎች አድርጎ ሁልጊዜ በድል ሰልፉ ይመራናል። በሄድንበትም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} እውቀት እንዲሰራጭ በእኛ ይጠቀማል፤ ይህም አየሩን እንደሚሞላ ጣፋጭ መዓዛ ነው።

decisions.choice: thanks: gratitude given to God
decisions.reason: χάρις usually means grace, but with "to God" and no verb it is the set phrase for giving thanks, as in 8:16, 9:15 and Romans 6:17. So the key term is not rendered "grace" here.

decisions.choice: God leads Paul and his co-workers in his triumphal procession, as those he has conquered
alternatives: God leads us as soldiers sharing in his victory
decisions.reason: θριαμβεύοντι is the word for a Roman triumph: the victory parade in which a general led his army and his captives through the city. The verb means to lead someone in such a parade, and those led are usually the conquered (as in Colossians 2:15). Paul pictures God as the victor and himself as one whom God has conquered and now displays, even in weakness and trouble. The older sense "causes us to triumph" has no clear support in Greek usage.

decisions.choice: fragrance: the incense of the parade and the scent of sacrifice
alternatives: a general picture of something spreading
decisions.reason: Incense was burned along the route of a triumph, and in the Old Testament a sacrifice is a soothing aroma to God (Genesis 8:21; Exodus 29:18). Verse 15 takes up the second picture.

decisions.choice: the fragrance is the knowledge of Christ
decisions.reason: The genitive explains what the fragrance is: knowing him. "Him" could be God, the subject of the sentence, or Christ, just named; verse 15 speaks of "the aroma of Christ", so Christ is more likely.

decisions.choice: in Christ: because they are joined to Christ
decisions.reason: God leads them in procession as people who belong to Christ and are united with him.

decisions.choice: thanks
decisions.reason: The key term is rendered "thanks" here because the sense is gratitude (m1).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article.

decisions.choice: like people he has conquered; because we are joined to; the knowledge of Christ
alternatives: leads us in triumph in Christ
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the picture of the triumph (m2), the sense of "in Christ" (m5), and who "him" is (m4).

decisions.choice: grâce soit rendue à Dieu (L, B); nous remercions Dieu (R)
decisions.reason: The sense is thanks (m1). French "rendre grâce" means to give thanks and keeps the key word "grâce" visible at Literal and Balanced; Readable says it in everyday words.

decisions.choice: nous mène en triomphe (L); nous emmène dans le cortège de son triomphe (B); dans son défilé de victoire (R)
decisions.reason: The familiar "nous fait triompher" makes Paul the victor; the verb means being led in the victor's procession, as those he has conquered (m2). "Mener en triomphe" says that in French.

decisions.choice: gracias
decisions.reason: Here the key word for grace means thanks given to God (meaning decision), and Spanish says this with its plural "gracias", the same root, so the link stays visible.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} conocimiento
decisions.reason: "Su conocimiento" is the natural Spanish for "the knowledge of him" and, like the Greek, can mean knowing him; Balanced spells it out as "el conocimiento de él".

decisions.choice: shukrani [ziwe] kwa Mungu (L); Mungu ashukuriwe (B); tumshukuru Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: The word that is "grace" elsewhere means thanks here (meaning decision). Swahili has no word that covers both, and "neema" would not be heard as thanks, so every level says "shukrani" or "kushukuru", in the same words as Romans 6:17.

decisions.choice: maandamano ya ushindi
decisions.reason: "Maandamano ya ushindi" is a victory procession, the Roman triumph the meaning decision describes; Readable adds "kama watu aliowashinda" as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "tạ ơn Đức Chúa Trời" for charis to theo; "cuộc diễn hành chiến thắng" for thriambeuo
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: charis here is "thanks" (m1), and "ân điển" is kept for grace. "Cuộc diễn hành chiến thắng" is the phrase of the Vietnamese Colossians 2:15 for the same picture.

decisions.choice: "감사" at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word usually translated "grace" as the set phrase for giving thanks, as in 1 Corinthians 15:57.

decisions.choice: "개선 행렬" (L, B); "승리 행렬 ... 그분이 이기신 사람들처럼" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the verb as God leading Paul in his triumphal procession, as those he has conquered, uncertain and footnoted; Korean keeps the picture of the Roman triumph, not a plain "makes us win".

decisions.choice: graças a Deus
decisions.reason: Portuguese "graças a Deus" says "thanks" with the same word as "graça" (grace), as the Greek does, so Literal and Balanced keep the link with the key term without strain. Readable uses the verb "agradecer", as the English Readable says "we thank".

decisions.choice: perfume (here and 2:16); aroma agradável (2:15)
decisions.reason: Two words, as the English keeps "fragrance" and "pleasing aroma": "perfume" for the scent spread everywhere, and "aroma agradável", the phrase for the pleasing smell of a sacrifice (m3 in 2:15). Readable says "cheiro", the everyday word.

decisions.choice: ምስጋና (thanks)
decisions.reason: Here charis means gratitude to God, as the meaning decision says, so Amharic uses ምስጋና; ጸጋ, the key term for grace, would not be understood as thanks. The same holds in 8:16 and 9:15.

decisions.choice: በድል ሰልፍ መምራት (lead in a victory procession); ሽታ (smell) for osmē, መዓዛ (fragrance) for euōdia
decisions.reason: The Greek verb pictures a Roman triumphal parade, so Amharic says ሰልፍ, 'procession', rather than simply 'give victory'. Two Greek words for scent are kept apart: ሽታ, 'smell, odour', which can be good or bad (2:16), and መዓዛ, 'fragrance, pleasing aroma'.
